references.text: God tells Moses that He will wipe out the people and make Moses into a great nation, almost identical wording to Deuteronomy 9:14
Moses asks God to blot his name from the book, contrasting with God's threat to blot out Israel's name
God threatens to strike the people with plague and make Moses into a greater and more powerful nation, a parallel situation with the same promise
God's promise to make Abraham into a great nation; the same expression 'goy gadol' is used
Command to blot out Amalek's name from under heaven, using the same phrase 'blot out the name from under heaven'
Warning that the Lord will blot out the names of the disobedient from under heaven, the same threat and language
Prayer that the names of the wicked be blotted out, using the same concept of blotting out names
